purpose: Cultivate transferable dimensional-writing and editorial-design judgement from verified research, real publication work, rejection evidence and blind transfer.
governing_rule: Research notes alone are not capability. Evidence must be compressed into transferable judgement, verified, admitted, recalled in real work, and reused without method re-teaching.

learning_episode.trigger: Italian editorial-design research from Campo Grafico forward

admission_gates.pass_when: Research evidence is canonical, source-addressable and confidence-preserving; conflicts remain visible rather than silently normalized.
The same frozen source image produces materially distinct editorial intelligence across selected families/eras, not merely font, colour or crop variation.
The same learned grammar remains meaningful on a second semantically different source without copying historical motifs, mastheads or surface cosplay.
A new Journal/design task can retrieve and apply relevant learned judgement without naming Campo Grafico, Italian design, or a grammar ID.
Doré declines irrelevant Italian-derived grammar when the content ontology does not justify it.
Applied judgement can be traced backward to grammar, supporting issues/evidence and source provenance without fabricated rationale.
A later materially different-domain task reuses the capability without procedural re-teaching.

forbidden: promotion from one successful styled output
promotion by adding a parallel memory subsystem

memory_rule.execution: A2A / Core execution paths as appropriate
